english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the Western board game, especially when distinguishing it from Chinese chess.

examples.english: I already knew how to play chess when I was little.
examples.traditional: 我細個已經識玩國際象棋。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 sik1 waan2 gwok3 zai3 zoeng6 kei4
